conviction_note: The Q3 numbers that usually move a print are already out: revenue of EUR 207.8m, an adjusted EBIT margin of 3.7% and the FY2026 guide were all in an Art. 17 ad-hoc on 2026-10-19, alongside a Capital Markets Day that set targets through 2031. What the Nov 3 statement adds is Q3 cash flow (H1 net operating cash flow was EUR -13.1m against a FY guide of EUR 10-20m), detail on the segments and possibly a narrower FY range. That gives abs_move 3.5% (European base of about 3% for a pre-released period, raised for 53% realised vol and $0.9m/day of turnover), p_up 50, so the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to -0.3, which is small and consistent with the scaled number.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (adj. EBIT margin 2-4%, sales +0-2%) was confirmed on 2026-10-19 with Q3 already closed, and margins of 3.0/3.6/3.7% put 9M at about 3.4%, the upper half of the range. A narrowing toward the top is the one guidance change plausible on Nov 3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints where the guide was confirmed moved +1.06% (2026-08-11) and +1.62% (2026-05-05). The 10-19 pre-release with a confirmed guide and the CMD fell 2.6%. The 2025 guide cut and later warnings coincided with larger falls (2025-05-06 -6.0%).
findings.original_quote: The outlook for fiscal year 2026 is confirmed.
findings.why_not_priced: The confirmation itself is priced. Only a formal narrowing would be news, and the stock trading 10% below its pre-CMD level shows no one is paying for an upper-half outcome. It is still inside what was guided, so the finding is small.
findings.independence: Quarterly margins from the company's own releases: Q2 3.6% https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/norma-group-delivers-significantly-higher-profitability-in-the-second-quarter-of-2026-industry-applications-continues-to-grow/8d04dc44-85e6-4fe6-86a7-2d796e26f58f_en ; German press tally of 3.0/3.6/3.7% https://stock3.com/news/norma-will-weniger-ausschuetten-und-plant-langsames-wachstum-17338353

findings.finding: H1 2026 net operating cash flow was EUR -13.1m (Q1 -19.7m, Q2 +6.6m) against a FY guide of EUR 10-20m, so H2 needs EUR 23-33m. Q3 cash flow is the one material line the Nov 3 statement adds; the 10-19 confirmation limits the downside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history of a reaction to a cash-flow surprise at NORMA. The European analogue is Luceco, which fell 5.5% on free cash flow on a day it raised its guide.
findings.original_quote: Die Jahresprognose mit einem Umsatzplus von 0 bis 2 %, einer bereinigten EBIT-Marge von 2 bis 4 % und einem operativen Netto-Cashflow von 10 bis 20 Mio. EUR bestätigt der Konzern. (stock3, 2026-10-19) [The company confirms the annual forecast of sales growth of 0 to 2%, an adjusted EBIT margin of 2 to 4% and net operating cash flow of EUR 10 to 20m.]
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 cash flow was not in the 10-19 pre-release, so nobody has seen it. Management confirmed the cash guide knowing Q3, which caps the risk, and a weak Q3 that pushes the burden onto Q4 is the realistic bad case. The sign is close to balanced, so the finding is small with a wide range. Without a sourced Q3 cash consensus it stays capped.
findings.independence: Q2 cash flow of EUR 6.6m from the company's own release: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/norma-group-delivers-significantly-higher-profitability-in-the-second-quarter-of-2026-industry-applications-continues-to-grow/8d04dc44-85e6-4fe6-86a7-2d796e26f58f_en ; guide figures from https://stock3.com/news/norma-will-weniger-ausschuetten-und-plant-langsames-wachstum-17338353

findings.finding: The EUR 22.35 tender was about 17x oversubscribed in its residual allocation: 10,883,318 shares were offered and only 631,099 taken, so about 10.25m shares went back to holders who wanted out at EUR 22.35. That is roughly half of the about 19.4m shares still outstanding, a supply overhang on any post-print rally from EUR 15.4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the tender closed (2026-09-15) the stock has fallen from 18.3 to 15.4 (about -16%), with -4.9%, -6.3% and -6.0% days in mid-September and -9.7% / -5.3% on 10-07/08 with no filed cause.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the -18% over 60 days and -10% over 20 days are this overhang being worked off. What remains is a cap on how far a good print can run. Some of the residual tenders were arbitrage positions with no lasting wish to sell, which keeps this small.
findings.independence: stock3 says about 39% of share capital was bought back in two offers for over EUR 260m: https://stock3.com/news/norma-will-weniger-ausschuetten-und-plant-langsames-wachstum-17338353

findings.finding: CEO Birgit Seeger bought shares on Tradegate after the tender: EUR 14,668 at an average of EUR 16.84 on 2026-09-22 and EUR 4,992 at EUR 16.00 on 2026-09-23, about EUR 19.7k in all.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable. Insiders sold and tendered in August (Seeger, Wilhelms, Heymann).
findings.why_not_priced: Public for six weeks and token in size. It bought in late Q3 with knowledge of the quarter's run-rate, so it is a weak hint that Q3 was not bad, which the 10-19 pre-release has since confirmed. Near zero.

findings.finding: The buyback cancels 9.3m shares (29% of share capital), so per-share earnings and the net-cash position change mechanically. The payment settled by 2026-09-24, so the Q3 weighted share count is barely affected and FY numbers carry most of the effect.
findings.why_not_priced: Fully priced: the arithmetic is in every model and was announced months ago. Filed because it bears on the per-share lines; sized at 0.

baseline_tension: Little tension. The priced lean is mildly positive (+0.82, mostly the run-up term after a -10% 20-day fall), and the findings net to about zero: a mild positive on a possible guide narrowing offset by the cash-flow unknown and the tender-return overhang.
language_note: Only the German stock3 piece of 2026-10-19 gave the full FY2026 guide figures in one place, including net operating cash flow of EUR 10-20m; the English ad-hoc says only 'outlook confirmed'. That number is what makes the cash-flow finding.
stock3 (German) also gave the Q3 2025 continuing-operations base (EUR 197.5m, so Q3 is about +5%) and the about EUR 90m net cash after the buybacks, which the English releases do not state directly.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' and 'inside what was guided': the guidance finding went from +0.4 to +0.2, because the FY confirmation is already public and only a narrowing would be news.
'A pre-released period with an unchanged guide sits between 45 and 55' and reported_quarter findings at 4 of 14 on sign: p_up went from 52 to 50, which makes expected_move_pct 0.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): confirmed that cash flow is the line to watch; the cash finding's downside range is kept wide at -2.5.

'Understatement is the systematic error' / do not cap abs_move on the reaction history: abs_move stays at 3.5 (the pre-released base of about 3, raised for thin turnover and 53% realised vol) and was not cut toward the 1-2% moves on recent confirmed-guide prints.
